title: How to Permanently Unlist and Remove Your Number from Truecaller (2026)
html:
Simply uninstalling the Truecaller app from your smartphone does not remove your name, phone number, address, or email from their public search database. Truecaller's contact directory is built on crowdsourcing: if anyone who has your phone number saved in their address book installs Truecaller and grants contact permissions, your details are uploaded to Truecaller's servers even if you have never installed the app yourself. Here is the exact two-step verified method to permanently unlist and delete your mobile number from Truecaller.

Last updated: 25 Nov 2026. This technical privacy guide covers the mandatory in-app account deactivation followed by Truecaller's web unlisting portal workflow.

Why Uninstalling the App Leaves Your Data Exposed

When you delete an app from Android or iPhone, the app's local files are removed from your device, but your profile remains live on their cloud servers. In Truecaller's case, if you uninstall without deactivating, strangers can still search your phone number and see your full name, email address, and approximate location.

Furthermore, if you never created an account but your name appears on Truecaller, you are listed in their "Enhanced Search" crowdsourced directory. To delete your record completely, you must follow the two-step protocol below.

Step 1: Deactivate Your Truecaller Account in the App First

(If you currently have the Truecaller app installed, you must deactivate inside the app before submitting the web unlist request. If you never installed Truecaller, jump straight to Step 2).

  1. Open the Truecaller app on your phone.
  2. Tap on your Profile avatar (or three dots menu in the top left/right corner).
  3. Tap on Settings (gear icon).
  4. Select Privacy Center.
  5. Scroll down to the bottom of the Privacy Center and tap Deactivate.
  6. Read the warning prompt. Truecaller will warn you that your profile data will be detached from your device. Tap Yes to confirm.
  7. Confirm the final prompt. You will be logged out, and your local profile is deactivated.
  8. Now uninstall the Truecaller app from your phone.

Step 2: Submit the Permanent Unlist Request on Truecaller Web

Now that your local account is deactivated, you must instruct Truecaller's central directory servers to purge your phone number from global search results:

  1. Open a browser on your phone or computer (preferably in an Incognito or Private tab) and go to: https://www.truecaller.com/unlisting.
  2. Scroll down to the phone number input box.
  3. Enter your phone number including your country code. For India, enter +91 followed by your 10-digit number (e.g., +919876543210). Entering without +91 will cause an error.
  4. Choose a reason for unlisting (e.g., "I don't want to be searchable" or "I'm concerned about privacy").
  5. Complete the Google reCAPTCHA verification to prove you are human.
  6. Click the red Unlist Phone Number button.
  7. A final pop-up will appear stating: "Are you sure you want to unlist your phone number?". Click Unlist to finalize.

Step 3: The 24-Hour Cache Purge & Verification

Truecaller states that unlisting requests can take up to 24 hours to propagate across their global Content Delivery Network (CDN) and search caching clusters.

How to verify that your number has been removed:

  1. Wait 24 hours after submitting the unlist form.
  2. Open an incognito browser window and visit truecaller.com.
  3. Search your phone number. It should return "No results found" or prompt for a login without displaying your name.
  4. Ask a friend or colleague who has Truecaller installed on their phone to search your number. Your earlier custom name, profile photo, and email should no longer appear.

How to Prevent Your Number from Being Added Back

Can your number reappear on Truecaller in the future? Yes, if a friend who saves your number under a new name installs Truecaller with full address book sync, Truecaller's algorithm may re-index your number under the new label.

To keep your number permanently private:

  • Never install Truecaller and log in again with that mobile number (logging in instantly cancels the unlisting).
  • If your name reappears months later, simply revisit truecaller.com/unlisting and submit a fresh unlist request.
  • Combine Truecaller unlisting with official telecom DND—read our guide on how to activate strict TRAI DND 1909 on Jio, Airtel, and Vi to stop spam telemarketing at the carrier level.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I unlist a Truecaller number if I have a Truecaller Premium subscription?

If you have an active Truecaller Premium subscription, you must cancel your subscription via Google Play Store (or Apple App Store) first before deactivating your account. Deactivating your account does not automatically refund or cancel recurring store subscriptions.

Does unlisting my number stop spam calls?

No. Unlisting only stops random people and scammers from searching your phone number to discover your real name, address, and email. To block promotional telemarketing calls, activate TRAI DND by sending START 0 to 1909.

Can government agencies or police still identify my number without Truecaller?

Yes. Truecaller is a commercial third-party app. Law enforcement agencies and telecom operators rely on statutory KYC subscriber databases (CAF records) maintained by your telecom carrier (Jio, Airtel, Vi), not Truecaller.
